LanguageData.LP_WS_Counterspell.label: counterspell
LanguageData.LP_WS_Counterspell.description: On guard: the next enemy spell or psychic ability within 20 cells will be interrupted (-15% success per level the opponent's ability is above 3).
LanguageData.LP_WS_Polymorphed.label: polymorph: rabbit form
LanguageData.LP_WS_Polymorphed.description: Turned into a rabbit: can't hold weapons or use abilities, manipulation -90%, movement ×0.6, can only bite for 1 damage.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Stoneskin.label: stoneskin
LanguageData.LP_WS_Stoneskin.description: Skin hard as rock (concentration): sharp, blunt and piercing damage taken ×0.6.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Phantasm.label: phantasmal killer
LanguageData.LP_WS_Phantasm.description: A terrifying phantom only it can see (concentration): every 2 seconds a 55% chance to take psychic damage and be frightened.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Dominated.label: dominated
LanguageData.LP_WS_Dominated.description: Mind dominated by a wizard, temporarily fighting for the colony; afterwards returns to its original side and is stunned for 5 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Summoned.label: summoned creature
LanguageData.LP_WS_Summoned.description: A creature summoned by a spell; dissipates when time is up.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Hound.label: faithful hound
LanguageData.LP_WS_Hound.description: An invisible magic watchdog: warns when enemies come within 15 cells and bites harder; dissipates when time is up.
LanguageData.LP_WS_TrueSeeing.label: true seeing
LanguageData.LP_WS_TrueSeeing.description: Sees through all illusions: invisible enemies within 30 cells are revealed; unaffected by magical darkness and blindness.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Blinded.label: blinded
LanguageData.LP_WS_Blinded.description: Blinded by a dazzling light: sight -80%.
LanguageData.LP_WS_SunbeamCharge.label: sunbeam
LanguageData.LP_WS_SunbeamCharge.description: Holding a beam of sunlight in the palm (concentration): meanwhile sunbeam costs no mana with a 6-second cooldown.
LanguageData.LP_WS_StoneCurse.label: petrifying curse
LanguageData.LP_WS_StoneCurse.description: Stone marks left by flesh to stone (severity = number of successes so far): full petrification at 3 in total.
LanguageData.LP_WS_StoneCurse.stages.1.label: two marks
LanguageData.LP_WS_Levitating.label: reverse gravity
LanguageData.LP_WS_Levitating.description: Floating in midair, unable to move; takes blunt damage falling down when it ends.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Ethereal.label: etherealness
LanguageData.LP_WS_Ethereal.description: On the Ethereal Plane: can't be targeted and takes no damage; attacking or casting a damaging spell returns you to the Material Plane.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Mansion.label: magnificent mansion
LanguageData.LP_WS_Mansion.description: Resting in a wizard's extradimensional mansion: rest recovery ×1.2, the caravan won't be ambushed.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Feebleminded.label: feeblemind
LanguageData.LP_WS_Feebleminded.description: Mind shattered: can't cast spells or psychic abilities for 30 days.
LanguageData.LP_WS_MindBlank.label: mind blank
LanguageData.LP_WS_MindBlank.description: The mind is completely sealed: immune to psychic damage, mental breaks and all mind control.
LanguageData.LP_WS_TimeStop.label: time stop
LanguageData.LP_WS_TimeStop.description: Time stops for the caster: wizard spells trigger no cooldown after casting.
LanguageData.LP_WS_WishStress.label: wish backlash
LanguageData.LP_WS_WishStress.description: The price of bending reality: manipulation and movement sharply reduced.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Foresight.label: foresight
LanguageData.LP_WS_Foresight.description: Seeing the next moment: 50% chance to dodge when attacked, melee hit +25%, shooting accuracy ×1.25.
